name: Syschem (India) Limited
summary: Syschem India Limited is a company focused on manufacturing active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), chemical intermediates, and specialized chemical products. Its offerings include a range of antibiotics like amoxicillin tri hydrate, ampicillin tri hydrate, cloxacillin sodium, dicloxacillin sodium, flucloxacillin sodium, oxacillin, and cephalexin. The firm began operations on December 31, 1993, and its main office is located in Chandigarh, India.
